title: Unit 35 Consolidation: Digital Ethics
goal: I can use the words for information, profiling, data protection, brain and machine, and responsibility.
I can say what may have happened, describe a program with a participle, state a request with *hogy* + subjunctive, compare and use *mintha*.
I can write one sentence about a machine with *mintha* or about responsibility with *minél … annál*.
